verifying_messages: Meditating on the Doctrines of Order...

asalto_frontera.description: A necromancer bandit leads a raid on the village outside the wall.
asalto_frontera.name: Frontier Assault
asalto_frontera.narrative: "Damn it! Cover my flank." —the sergeant shouts as he draws his sword against the skeletons.

caza_luna.description: Farmers report disappearances on full moon nights. Beasts that walk like men.
caza_luna.name: Hunt Under the Moon
caza_luna.narrative: The dense forest limits visibility. Something moves in the shadows.

ecos_abismo.description: A rift in reality has opened near the mines. A horde of minor demons crossed through.
ecos_abismo.name: Echoes of the Abyss
ecos_abismo.narrative: The miners didn't escape. Now you must close what was opened.

limpieza_ruinas.description: An old watchtower has been occupied by restless spirits. Purify it to restore the line of sight.
limpieza_ruinas.name: Ruins Cleansing
limpieza_ruinas.narrative: The old tower creaks with each gust of wind. Whispers echo from above.

mansion_sangrienta.description: A local noble has been accused of vampirism. The order sends you to 'interview' him.
mansion_sangrienta.name: Bloody Mansion
mansion_sangrienta.narrative: The ballroom is empty, but the chandeliers sway without wind.

profundidades_catedral.description: Neighbors complain about strange noises beneath the city. A heretic cult in the catacombs.
profundidades_catedral.name: Cathedral Depths
profundidades_catedral.narrative: "We need to investigate further. Stay alert." The air smells of sulfur.

puente_suspiros.description: An enemy convoy attempts to cross the river with prisoners. Intercept them.
puente_suspiros.name: Bridge of Sighs
puente_suspiros.narrative: The narrow bridge offers no retreat. Victory or death.

ruta_suministros.description: Your squad escorts a supply cart to the front. The forest is eerily silent.
ruta_suministros.name: Supply Route
ruta_suministros.narrative: "Birds don't sing when predators are near." "Eyes open. I don't trust those shadows."

sabotaje_naval.description: Infiltrate the siege ships during a storm.
sabotaje_naval.name: Naval Sabotage
sabotaje_naval.narrative: "Swimming in this rain is suicide, but it's our only chance."
